cases.note: masks env values that look sensitive by key or value (verbatim from .test.ts)
masks various sensitive key shapes case-insensitively; non-sensitive key+value stays visible

masks known token value shapes; too-short token-like values stay visible. The Slack value is written with a \u0078 escape (it decodes to the same string) because a published file may not carry a contiguous token-shaped literal.
value at the 12-char token boundary is masked even under a neutral key
empty env yields empty masked record
mixed entries: sensitive key masked, plain key with plain value preserved
non-string values are coerced with String(x); reading them as strings and defaulting is what silently emptied a credential-bearing map
257 env fields drop the whole map (undefined on the TS leg, null here — undefined has no JSON image)
an env key over the 4 KiB name cap drops the whole map
an env value over the 64 KiB field cap drops the whole map
